rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the order of events by when they happened.

example.english: Put the information in chronology first; I want to see how the whole thing developed.
example.traditional: 你幫我將啲資料跟返時間順序排好先，我想睇返件事點樣發展。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 di1 zi1 liu2 gan1 faan2 si4 gaan3 seon6 zeoi6 paai4 hou2 sin1 ngo5 soeng2 tai2 faan2 gin6 si6 dim2 joeng2 faat3 zin2

rows.note: Use this when the chronological arrangement is shown visually as a timeline.

example.english: We made a timeline, so the chronology of the whole thing is clear at a glance.
example.traditional: 我哋整咗條時間線，成件事嘅發展一目了然。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zing2 zo2 tiu4 si4 gaan1 sin3 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 faat3 zin2 jat1 muk6 liu5 jin4

rows.note: Use this for the academic study of determining when events happened and their order.

example.english: Chronology is the academic study of the dates and order of historical events.
example.traditional: 年代學呢門學問，係研究歷史事件發生嘅年代同先後次序。
example.jyutping: nin4 doi6 hok6 ne1 mun4 hok6 man6 hai6 jin4 gau3 lik6 si2 si6 gin2 faat3 sang1 ge3 nin4 doi6 tung4 sin1 hau6 ci3 zeoi6
